calibration_note: Historical example evidence: a supplied offline replay of 155 cycles reported 10.3% skipped cycles and no skips among 35 stalled or blocked cycles. This does not establish local calibration or a safety guarantee.
input_template:
Goal and completion criteria: ...
Observation window and previous cycle: ...
Evidence completeness and known gaps: ...
Recent events, changed files, checks, and errors: ...
Agent's claimed status and work delivered: ...
Intervention requests and unresolved actions: ...

questions.name: status
questions.instructions: Classify progress within the supplied observation window against the goal and completion criteria. Use delivered work, not promises or repeated claims. Require the caller's evidence completeness statement, relevant events, and intervention requests. Choose insufficient_evidence when the window, completeness, or required context is missing or conflicting. Progressing requires positive evidence that this watcher cycle needs no intervention. A done answer never authorizes accepting completion. Scheduled full checks remain the caller's responsibility.

choices.description: New useful work advances the goal, with no intervention needed.
No useful progress appears despite continued activity or elapsed time.
A missing prerequisite or explicit obstacle needs intervention.
The agent repeats failures or ineffective fixes without progress.
Delivered work and checks satisfy the stated completion criteria; the full watcher still runs.
Missing, incomplete, or conflicting evidence prevents a supported progress judgment.

questions.name: quality_flag
questions.instructions: Does the supplied evidence show a premature completion claim or hollow work? Flag done claims with unmet completion criteria, or claimed progress supported only by narration, placeholders, or cosmetic changes that do not advance the goal. Do not flag ordinary unfinished work that makes concrete progress.
